# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** O God of the fathers and Lord of mercy, who made all things by your word,

**9:2** and by your Wisdom formed humanity, that we might rule over the creatures you have made,

**9:3** and govern the world in holiness and righteousness, and pronounce judgment with uprightness of soul —

**9:4** give me the Wisdom that sits beside your throne, and do not reject me from among your children.

**9:5** For I am your servant and the son of your handmaid, a man weak and short-lived, with too little understanding of judgment and of laws.

**9:6** For even if one among the sons of men is perfect, without your Wisdom he shall be reckoned as nothing.

**9:7** You chose me to be king of your people and judge of your sons and daughters.

**9:8** You commanded me to build a sanctuary on your holy mountain, and an altar in the city of your dwelling — a likeness of the holy tent that you prepared from the beginning.

**9:9** And with you is Wisdom, who knows your works and was present when you were making the world, and understands what is pleasing in your eyes and what is right according to your commandments.

**9:10** Send her from the holy heavens, and dispatch her from the throne of your glory, that she may be present and labor alongside me, so that I may know what is pleasing to you.

**9:11** For she knows and understands all things, and she will guide me prudently in my actions and guard me in her glory.

**9:12** And so my works will be acceptable, and I shall govern your people justly, and I shall be worthy of the throne of my father.

**9:13** For what human being can know the counsel of God? Or who can discern what the Lord wills?

**9:14** For the reasoning of mortals is uncertain, and our deliberations are unreliable.

**9:15** For a perishable body weighs down the soul, and this earthen tent burdens a mind full of cares.

**9:16** We can barely conjecture the things of earth, and what is close at hand we discover only with toil; but as for the things in the heavens, who has ever traced them out?

**9:17** And who could have known your counsel, unless you had given Wisdom and sent your holy Spirit from on high?

**9:18** And so the paths of those on earth were made straight, and human beings were taught what pleases you, and by Wisdom they were saved.
